name: Joanna Robinson

bio.statement: In her voters' pamphlet statement, Robinson lists her occupation as behavioral health project coordinator and her background as research and administration.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Nov 3 2026 Voters' Pamphlet (edition Book7)

bio.statement: Her statement lists an MBA from the University of Nebraska-Lincoln and a BA from Reed College.
bio.excerpt: MBA, University of Nebraska-Lincoln; BA, Reed College

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Nov 3 2026 Voters' Pamphlet (edition Book7)

bio.statement: Her statement lists the Albany Public Safety Commission as prior governmental experience.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Nov 3 2026 Voters' Pamphlet (edition Book7)

positions.statement: Robinson says she would invest in affordable housing options and protect Oregonians from displacement with rental and mortgage assistance.
positions.excerpt: Investing in options people can actually afford, protecting Oregonians from displacement with rental and mortgage assistance.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Nov 3 2026 Voters' Pamphlet (edition Book7)

positions.statement: She says she would address the rural healthcare crisis by strengthening local clinics, investing in providers and lowering prescription costs.
positions.excerpt: Addressing the rural healthcare crisis by strengthening local clinics, investing in providers, and lowering prescription costs.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Nov 3 2026 Voters' Pamphlet (edition Book7)

positions.statement: She says she would invest in public education and job training through community colleges and registered apprenticeships.
positions.excerpt: Investing in public education and job training pathways through community colleges and registered apprentice- ships

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Nov 3 2026 Voters' Pamphlet (edition Book7)

positions.statement: She says she would lower the costs of childcare, utilities and groceries and take on price gouging.
positions.excerpt: Lowering the costs of everyday necessities like childcare, utilities, and groceries, and taking on price gouging and predatory corporate practices.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Nov 3 2026 Voters' Pamphlet (edition Book7)

positions.statement: She says she wants a fair, accountable tax system that eases the burden on working people and closes loopholes for large corporations.
positions.excerpt: A fair, accountable tax system that eases the burden on working people and closes the loopholes that let large corporations game the system.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Nov 3 2026 Voters' Pamphlet (edition Book7)

positions.statement: She says challenges from data centers to AI job displacement demand a leader who will show up and work for the community.
positions.excerpt: The challenges our state faces, from data centers to AI job displace- ment, demand a leader who will show up and work for us.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Nov 3 2026 Voters' Pamphlet (edition Book7)
